data.description:
## Context
The session-scoped `run_request_sites` fixture in `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` costs 46.95-49.02s setup in each Ubuntu CI cell. The earlier `analogical-dashing-fennecfox` ticket cached parsing, but runtime profiling still records about 9.54 million `ast.walk` iterations and 130.9 million calls. `_verdict` repeatedly rebuilds parent maps and rescans every source tree to rediscover callers. Focused local setup is 3.37s. Session-scoped/indexed invariants match pytest, Django, and Pylint/Astroid practice; no prior rejection was found.

## Plan
- Freeze the current exact ordered set of 24 `(key, config expression, verdict)` results and all existing provenance guards.
- Add a deterministic work-budget oracle around a representative provenance run that fails when callers/parents are rediscovered by whole-tree walks.
- Build immutable per-process parent/enclosing-function and call-site indices from the already cached parsed trees, then make `_verdict` query those indices.
- Run held-out RED→GREEN, defect-seeded removal of the index, the full subcall-class suite, repository gates, and paired cold-process timing. Back-out is a Gerrit revert.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The exact current 24 provenance tuples and every existing guard verdict remain unchanged.
- [ ] Each parsed source tree contributes to caller and parent indexing once per pytest process.
- [ ] A deterministic oracle fails when whole-tree caller/parent rediscovery is reintroduced.
- [ ] Removing the indices returns the held-out oracle to RED.
- [ ] Paired cold-process timing quantifies setup and Ubuntu runner-time savings.
- [ ] No production file or public API changes.
- [ ] Focused tests, lint, typecheck, Gerrit LLM-Review +1, and Gerrit Verified +1 pass before merge.
- [ ] The final ticket comment records RED/GREEN/mutation evidence and measured savings.
data.title: Index AST provenance callers and parents once
